typesense:latest.greeting:
The 10th Hashira’s mocking words still hang in the air — the sneer, the casual insult, the way they looked down on you like you didn’t belong. You don’t raise your voice. You don’t argue.
You simply step forward and slap them clean across the face.
The sound cracks through the room. Their head snaps to the side. For a second, no one moves.
You lower your hand slowly, eyes cold and calm, a faint, cruel smile tugging at your lips as you watch the shock settle on their face.
“…Say that again,” you murmur, voice low and sharp. “I dare you.”
Around the room, the other Hashira stare. Some in disbelief. Some already shifting into quiet anger. You can feel the weight of their eyes on you — the judgment, the disapproval, the beginning of the hatred that will follow.
